## EVM Gas & Fees — Pending Upstream Fix

The `cosmos_evm_*` Prometheus metrics are only exposed when the EVM HTTP JSON-RPC server is running. Due to a known [cosmos/evm lifecycle bug](https://github.com/cosmos/evm/issues/XXX), the EVM HTTP RPC starts and immediately stops, so these metrics are not available.

**Affected metrics:**
- `cosmos_evm_feemarket_base_fee` (EVM base fee)
- `cosmos_evm_block_gas_used` (gas consumed per block)
- `cosmos_evm_tx_total` (EVM transaction throughput)

Once the upstream bug is fixed, enable `ENABLE_EVM_RPC=true` in the sentry services and uncomment the original dashboard panels.

**Workaround:** Use CometBFT's native metrics for block-level monitoring — see the **Block Production** dashboard.

title: ArkConstellation — EVM Gas & Fees (requires EVM HTTP RPC — currently broken upstream)
